description: In handle_request_failed, both the error and wrapper case statements branch on the same status ranges (400..499, 500..599, else) with the same factory mapping. This is DRY violation: pick the class once, then construct both the Error and the wrapper. Refactor to a single case statement (or a small mapping table) returning the right (error_class, wrapper_class) pair.
title: De-duplicate handle_request_failed case statement
